newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: No Bank Melbourne ruling this week- ACCC.
newsitem.headline: No Bank Melbourne ruling this week- ACCC.

text.p: Australia's anti-monopolies authority said on Thursday it was unlikely to announce this week its decision on the proposed merger between Westpac Banking Corp and the Bank of Melbourne Ltd.
"(It) probably won't be until next week," an Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) spokeswoman told Reuters.
In April, Westpac offered A$9.75 a share for the Bank of Melbourne, valuing the regional bank at about A$1.4 billion. The bid is subject to approval by the ACCC.
At 12.40 p.m. (0240 GMT), Westpac shares were up seven cents at A$7.95, while Bank of Melbourne stock was down five to A$9.40.
